title: Heavenly Fate Returns
next_chapter_hook: The Tianji Sword emitted a tremor, and Chen Ji felt something within him about to awaken — a sight unseen for millennia.

text.content: The strange mutation of the River of Fate was like a wound torn open by an invisible hand, from the jet-black fissure gushing forth golden light unseen for millennia. That radiance was not warmth, but rather a pressure transcending mortal laws, causing the souls of all cultivators present to tremble. Chen Tianming's phantom grew increasingly distinct within the river, his eyes that had witnessed ten thousand years of vicissitudes burning with resentment and obsession. Chen Ji stood in place, feeling unprecedented agitation from the Tianji Record Fragments within his body — they were responding, echoing, yearning to return.

dialogue.content: (Inner turmoil hidden beneath a calm facade) So it's finally here? I've waited for this day for so long.

text.content: Cang Yutian hovered above the River of Fate, the Wheel of Laws spinning madly, releasing an overwhelming pressure. Yet at this moment, his pupils constricted sharply — an expression never seen on any being's face: terror. The strange mutation of the River of Fate had completely deviated from his calculations. Chen Tianming, who should have naturally perished after the thousand-year scheme, was manifesting in a way he had never anticipated. Cang Yutian realized there was some key variable he had missed, and the orchestrator of this variable was the ant he had never truly regarded — Chen Ji.

dialogue.content: (A voice carrying a hint of unprecedented trembling) This is impossible... How could a mere mortal interfere with the course of the River of Fate!

text.content: Chen Ji slowly raised his head, a faint, serene smile appearing on his seemingly ordinary face. He raised his hand, pointing toward Chen Tianming's phantom in the River of Fate, his voice cold as frost: "Eye of Heavenly Secrets, do you truly believe you control everything? What you see is what I want you to see; what you calculate is what I guide you to calculate." A sharp gleam flickered in his eyes, "Chen Tianming's return was from the very beginning part of my chess game — and you are merely a piece in the hands of the chess player."

dialogue.content: (A cold laugh) Arrogant! Do you think a mere fate imprint could change anything? An ant is still an ant!

text.content: At this moment, Chen Tianming's phantom within the River of Fate spoke. That voice traversed ten thousand years of time, carrying infinite weariness and release: "The thousand-year scheme concludes today." His form began to decompose, transforming into countless golden motes, like stars falling from the heavens to the mortal realm, "My son Chen Ji, I have left you everything I possess — not power, not authority, but a possibility." Those golden motes did not surge toward Chen Ji's body, but instead began permeating every Tianji Record Fragment within him, illuminating them one by one.

The Tianji Record Fragments within Chen Ji violently trembled, and on the first page, the fragmentary soul of Mo Xiansheng emerged. His gaze pierced through the river of time, looking toward those golden motes merging into Chen Ji, his eyes filled with relief: "A thousand years... I have finally waited for this day." Mo Xiansheng's form began to dissipate, but he felt no pain; instead, he wore a smile of liberation, "Chen Tianming, you succeeded. You found the only person capable of bearing the complete truth of the Tianji Record."

dialogue.content: (Looking at Chen Ji, eyes full of expectation) Chen Ji, from now on, you are no longer a user of the Tianji Record, but its inheritor. Remember, true prophecy is never about peeking at the future, but creating it. Go, my final knowledge awaits you on that last page.

text.content: Golden motes converged within Chen Ji, transforming into a warm current flowing along his meridians. The fragments of the Tianji Record began to merge, those once blurry characters becoming clear, those missing portions being completed. However, just as the merger reached its critical moment, Chen Ji felt unprecedented agony — two souls were fighting for control of the same body. Chen Tianming's thousand-year obsession and Chen Ji's twenty years of conviction collided violently, stirring a storm within his Mental Sea.

Chen Ji knelt on one knee, hands clutching his head, veins bulging on his forehead. His consciousness was being torn between two memories: on one side, Chen Tianming's loneliness and resolve as the master of the Tianji Record for ten thousand years; on the other, his own twenty years of endurance and scheming as a废物. The two wills clashed within him, neither willing to yield. Upon seeing this, Cang Yutian's terror gradually transformed into ferocious joy: "So that's it! The price of merger is soul laceration! Chen Tianming, you were ultimately too naive!"

choice.prompt: The two souls clashed in the Mental Sea, and Chen Ji had to make a choice: be devoured by Chen Tianming's will to become the new vessel, or maintain his own consciousness to complete true fusion?

choices.text: Using self-will as the guiding force
choices.description: Uphold Chen Ji's memories and personality, allowing Chen Tianming's thousand-year wisdom to serve him, rather than being devoured by his will.
choices.visible_cost: Fusion speed may slow, possibly giving Cang Yutian an opening
choices.visible_reward: Maintain complete self, gain Chen Tianming's thousand-year wisdom without losing humanity
choices.risk_hint: Failure will result in complete loss of self-awareness

text.content: Chen Ji spread his arms wide in the Mental Sea, allowing Chen Tianming's memories to flood in like a tide, yet without closing his own consciousness defense. "You are you, I am I." His voice echoed in the Mental Sea, "Your regrets, I will accomplish; your wisdom, I will inherit. But Chen Ji will always be just Chen Ji." Golden light began swirling around his consciousness core instead of trying to devour it.

choices.description: Completely open consciousness, allowing Chen Tianming's will and one's own will to fully merge, becoming the true complete inheritor of the Tianji Record.
choices.visible_cost: May lose some original personality and interpersonal relationships after fusion
choices.visible_reward: Gain complete Tianji Record power and Chen Tianming's full memories

text.content: Chen Ji chose another path. He completely opened his consciousness, allowing Chen Tianming's ten-thousand-year will and wisdom to overwhelm him. The two consciousnesses were like two converging rivers, gradually merging into one. Chen Tianming's aged resolve and Chen Ji's youthful cunning, in the fusion, gave birth to a completely new existence. "This is... the true inheritor of the Tianji Record." Chen Tianming's voice and Chen Ji's voice spoke simultaneously, perfectly overlapping.

choices.description: By displaying Chen Tianming's ten-thousand-year loneliness and regrets through the Tianji Record, completing the inheritance through emotion rather than power, resolving the confrontation between the two souls.
choices.visible_cost: Requires consuming a large amount of Heavenly Fate Value
choices.visible_reward: Gain complete recognition from Chen Tianming, fusion process painless, and unlock hidden ability 'Heavenly Fate Resonance'
choices.risk_hint: If Heavenly Fate Value is insufficient, fusion may be interrupted

text.content: Chen Ji chose not to resist, nor to submit. He mobilized the residual Heavenly Fate power within his body, constructing scene after scene in the Mental Sea: those were Chen Tianming's countless days and nights alone guarding the Tianji Record across ten thousand years; that was one person's loneliness and despair in the darkness against the entire Heavenly Dao. "Elder, you are tired." Chen Ji's voice carried unprecedented gentleness, "Let me bear the heavy burden from now on." Chen Tianming's obsession gradually dissipated in this understanding, transforming into the purest power.

At the critical moment of fusion, the final page of the Tianji Record slowly unfolded. There were no characters upon it, only an imprint radiating soft light — that was the 'Heavenly Fate Mark' condensed from Chen Tianming's lifelong dedication, his final gift to Chen Ji. The mark slowly drifted toward Chen Ji's Brow Center, and upon contact, he felt a brand-new realm: the Heavenly Fate Eye. No longer the lofty overlooking of the Heavenly Secrets Eye, but a契合 with fate breathing and sharing destiny.

dialogue.content: (Voice carrying unprecedented fear) No! This is not any possibility I foresaw! What have you done!

text.content: Chen Ji slowly rose to his feet, his eyes gleaming with gold and silver intertwined light — the mark of the Heavenly Fate Mark and Tianji Record's perfect fusion. He felt the earth-shaking changes within his body: the Tianji Record fragments were no longer a burden but truly became part of his body; Chen Tianming's thousand-year wisdom was no longer foreign memories but instinct as if born with it. He looked at Cang Yutian, the corner of his mouth curving meaningfully: "Did you think I was merely waiting for Chen Tianming's inheritance? No, I was creating a possibility you could never calculate."

choice.prompt: After fusion completion, Chen Ji, facing the Heavenly Secrets Eye's interrogation, must make a response. Directly provoke, or conceal and wait?

choices.description: Before the Heavenly Secrets Eye, declare his rebirth, overwhelming the opponent's psychological defenses with absolute momentum.
choices.visible_cost: May expose too much power information
choices.visible_reward: Greatly enhance Reputation, causing the Heavenly Secrets Eye to fall into self-doubt
choices.risk_hint: May attract stronger Heavenly Dao backlash

text.content: Chen Ji stepped forward, his aura surging like a rainbow, gold and silver intertwined light forming a brilliant halo behind him. He stared directly at the Heavenly Secrets Eye's consciousness, his voice loud and resolute: "The thousand-year chess game concludes today. From now on, the Tianji Record is no longer a piece in your scheme for the world — but the orchestrator of orchestrators!"

choices.text: Nonchalantly, playing the pig to eat the tiger
choices.description: Do not directly respond to the Heavenly Secrets Eye's interrogation, with a dismissive attitude implying the opponent is merely so-so, maintaining mystery.
choices.visible_cost: May cause the Heavenly Secrets Eye to believe there is still a chance
choices.visible_reward: Maintain strategic advantage, leaving room for future schemes
choices.risk_hint: May cause allies to misunderstand the protagonist's attitude

text.content: Chen Ji did not respond to the Heavenly Secrets Eye's interrogation, merely calmly tidying his sleeves, as if that heaven-shaking fusion was but a trivial matter. He turned to look at the gradually calming waters of the River of Fate, lightly saying: "In your calculations, did you foresee this moment?" The tone carried a hint of playfulness, yet no emotion of anger or triumph was revealed.

The River of Fate finally returned to calm, but everyone knew this world had changed. Chen Ji stood by the river, feeling the Tianji Record's unprecedented completeness within his body. That was not merely an elevation of power, but a cognitive leap — for the first time, he truly saw his position in the game of fate. No longer a piece to be manipulated, but an orchestrator holding the chessboard. The Tianji Sword in his body emitted joyful tremors, as if celebrating this reunion delayed ten thousand years. And that final page of Mo Xiansheng's testament awaited Chen Ji to savor carefully in the next lonely night.

Just then, the Tianji Sword suddenly emitted a tremor. That sound was neither anger nor joy, but a near-instinctive warning. Chen Ji felt something within him about to awaken — a sight unseen for millennia. Between his brows, a vertical line interweaving gold and silver slowly emerged, like a third eye opening. That was the Heavenly Fate Eye, an observation ability at a higher level transcending the Heavenly Secrets Eye. Chen Tianming's ten-thousand-year wishful longing was fulfilled at this moment. And beyond the River of Fate, countless beings who had been watching this moment were all reassessing this young man once regarded as an ant.
